leads.title: State Law No. 14,896 - Legislative Assembly of Rio Grande do Sul
leads.documents: State-level prohibition of discrimination based on sexual orientation in Rio Grande do Sul
leads.detail: Enacted December 19, 2002 by the Legislative Assembly of Rio Grande do Sul; cited as State Law No. 14,896. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court - 2019 nationwide gender identity discrimination ban
leads.documents: Nationwide prohibition of discrimination based on gender identity in Brazil, applicable in Rio Grande do Sul
leads.detail: Described as decision by the Supreme Federal Court, effective since 2019. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling of 1 March 2018 on name and sex change
leads.documents: Right of transgender person to change official name and sex by self-declaration without surgery or professional evaluation
leads.detail: Dated 1 March 2018, Supreme Federal Court of Brazil, based on self-declaration of psychosocial identity. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Government of Rio Grande do Sul - 27 January 2020 restroom signage policy
leads.documents: Installation of signs in women's restrooms of state government offices allowing use in accordance with gender identity, plus unisex restrooms
leads.detail: Dated 27 January 2020 - National Trans Visibility Day; state government offices measure. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Statement by Special Secretary of Culture Mario Frias - August 2021
leads.documents: Federal-level criticism of Rio Grande do Sul restroom inclusivity measures as posing risks to children, showing enforcement contestation
leads.detail: Attributed to Special Secretary of Culture Mario Frias, August 2021. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Rio Grande do Sul Justice provision of 22 April 2022 on non-binary rectification
leads.documents: Assured non-binary people could change first name and sex in birth record including 'non-binary' in sex field via notary without judicial authorization
leads.detail: Dated April 22, 2022, Rio Grande do Sul Justice, request to notary's office based on self-perceived identity. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Court of Justice of Rio Grande do Sul - December 2023 revocation
leads.documents: Revocation of the provision that recognized non-binary rectification in the state
leads.detail: Dated December 2023, Court of Justice of Rio Grande do Sul. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Porto Alegre court order of 28 September 2025 - bar restroom denial case
leads.documents: Documented incident: court ordered bar to pay 10,000 reais compensation after denying trans man access to men's restroom
leads.detail: Dated September 28, 2025, court in Porto Alegre, 10,000 reais compensation. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Appellate court decision of 28 May 2026 overturning restroom case
leads.documents: Overturning of the 2025 Porto Alegre restroom-access compensation order, showing enforcement outcome
leads.detail: Dated May 28, 2026, appellate court. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Porto Alegre gender-neutral language ban and Supreme Federal Court strike-down
leads.documents: Municipal restriction on gender-neutral language in schools and its invalidation by Supreme Federal Court, showing rights machinery
leads.detail: Approved May 4, 2022 by Porto Alegre City Council 20-11, signed by Mayor Sebastiao Melo (MDB) June 15, 2022, published Official Gazette on the 17th; struck down April 24, 2025 by Supreme Federal Court along with similar laws from Sao Goncalo and Muriae. No URL visible in text.
